title: A Rainy Day
summary: A short story in the past simple — regular and irregular verbs, weather.
text:
Last Sunday the weather was terrible. It rained all day. Lucía wanted to go to the beach with her sister, but they stayed at home.

In the morning they made pancakes. Lucía broke two eggs on the floor, and her sister laughed a lot. The kitchen was a disaster, but the pancakes were delicious.

After breakfast they watched an old film about a dog. Lucía cried at the end. Her sister said, "It is only a film!" but she cried too.

In the afternoon the rain stopped for one hour. They went outside and walked to the shop on the corner. They bought chocolate and came back quickly, because the sky was grey again.

At night Lucía wrote in her diary: "Today we did not go to the beach. We ate pancakes, we watched a sad film and we got wet. It was a very good day."

questions.q: Where did Lucía want to go?
Why did they come back quickly?
How did Lucía feel about the day?
options: It was a very good day
